name: We Met v8.8.0 Clean Layout and Direct Wallet Checkout
changes: Removes solid signed-in headers and moves logout out of customer/listener headers
Flattens profile, settings and listener home sections to reduce floating card and card-inside-card styling
Admin listener editing now uses upload-only profile photo and banner controls; avatar selection is removed
Admin can save listener banner images through the backend update endpoint
Customer call screen uses the listener banner/profile as the visual background; listener call styling matches the customer call theme
Wallet Pay click prevents default navigation and opens Razorpay Standard Checkout directly on the wallet with redirect disabled
Updates cache/service-worker asset version to v8.8.0
